root_region_pixels.unqualified_reason: One distinct scroll pose: header/footer fixed, all15 scroll text nodes translated equally; no aligned/registered pixel PASS claimed.

pixel_qualification_limit: Seven matched-pose pairs qualify with zero changed pixels outside caption ROIs. One iPadXXXL list pose has uniform4.6433pt scroll translation, fixed header/footer and unchanged text sizes/relative geometry; original direct comparison failure preserved, no registered-image PASS.

issue_progress_archive.reason: Issue progress body nearing GitHub length limit; preserve full old body in versioned repository and original goal/scope/work/acceptance/test boundary prefix verbatim in concise current issue.

limits: Only named caption roles, normal/largest Accessibility category and two simulators.
Existing four before runs reused by exact source/binary/capture receipts; not reported as four new runs.
Uniform-background root measurements do not establish native heterogeneous glass or all editor/control contrast.
100th darkest foreground-pixel contrast is a qualified screenshot core measurement, not every antialiased edge or a physical photometric/assistive certification.
Geometry/pixel guard covers captured root poses, not all Face variants/options or languages.
No real Home/accounts/audio/camera/messages/calls/native alarms/new Live Activities. Physical/signing hold unchanged.
